record.content: The current college permit page states that visitors and students without semester permits need a daily permit. It publishes a $4 daily rate, identifies permit kiosks in most lots and on all levels near the South Parking Structure elevator at the Fremont campus, offers mobile purchase by QR code, and says a daily permit is valid only on its purchase date at either campus. It separately limits hourly permits to two hours in marked hourly stalls in Lot P.
record.observer: Wayproof live source review via browser
